seo.title: SmartPRS 3.0 — HR, Payroll & QR Attendance Software for India | Ametecs
seo.description: SmartPRS 3.0 by Ametecs: HRMS, India-compliant payroll, leave, PF/ESI/PT/TDS and built-in QR code attendance with a mobile app — no biometric device needed. Cloud from ₹1,500/month or a lifetime on-premises licence.

hero.title: SmartPRS 3.0 — Complete HR & Payroll. Now with Smart QR Attendance.
hero.subtitle: From Attendance to Payroll — One Smart Platform. No Biometric Device Required. QR check-in at the gate, leave, India-compliant payroll, PF / ESI / PT / TDS and RBI agent audit reports — in the cloud or on your own server.

features.title: Dashboard
features.desc: Your live command centre — headcount, attendance, payroll and escalation KPIs at a glance.

features.title: Approvals & Alerts
features.desc: One approvals inbox for leave, regularizations, advances and letters — with notifications, email/WhatsApp alerts and an escalation desk.

features.title: Live Salary
features.desc: Each employee's salary earned so far this month, updated as attendance comes in — no surprises on payday.

features.title: Hiring & Onboarding
features.desc: Requisitions with approval, job-portal imports into a talent pool, hiring drives, WhatsApp invites, interviews and one-click hire.

features.title: People
features.desc: One source of truth for every employee — profiles, teams, documents and org structure.

features.title: Time & Attendance
features.desc: Biometric (ZKTeco, cloud, CSV) and geo-fenced selfie punch, named working shifts with night allowance, rosters and a wizard-built late policy.

features.title: QR Attendance
features.desc: A rotating QR at each office gate, scanned in the SmartPRS app — geo-fenced, approved phones only, no device to buy.

features.title: Employee Mobile App
features.desc: Android app for punch-in, attendance, leave, payslips and approvals — each phone activated once with a code.

features.title: Leave
features.desc: Leave types, balances, holiday calendars and self-service approval workflows.

features.title: Payroll
features.desc: Automated, India-compliant payroll — shift-aware late cuts, night allowance, A4 payslips with a plain-English calculation note on every slip.

features.title: Compensation & Claims
features.desc: Salary structures, reimbursements, expenses, advances and loans — all with approvals.

features.title: Statutory & Compliance
features.desc: PF, ESI, PT and TDS returns — plus one-click RBI agent audit reports (single or bulk) on your own letterhead, with a verdict per agent.

features.title: Performance & Rewards
features.desc: Goals, reviews, incentives, points and leaderboards that keep field teams driven.

features.title: Learning & Knowledge
features.desc: Training programs, courses, assessments, FAQs and a searchable knowledge base.

features.title: HR Helpdesk
features.desc: Employees raise HR queries and tickets; HR answers, tracks and closes them with a full history.

features.title: HR Letters
features.desc: Offer, appointment, increment, warning and relieving letters from smart templates.

features.title: Field Force
features.desc: Off-roll agents, DRA/PCC compliance, geo-tracking and the bank escalation desk.

features.title: Assets
features.desc: Asset stock, issue and return to employees, branch-wise tracking and a My Assets page for every employee.

features.title: Communication
features.desc: Notice board, announcements and targeted email, SMS and WhatsApp messaging.

features.title: Reports & Analytics
features.desc: Attendance, payroll, compliance and workforce insights — exportable on demand.

features.title: Administration
features.desc: Companies, roles, masters, policy repository, exit clearance and a tamper-evident (hash-chained) audit trail of every change.

features.title: Organization Setup
features.desc: Companies, branches, departments, designations, teams, shifts, holidays, salary structures, payslip and ID-card formats — all on screen.

features.title: AI Assistant
features.desc: Ask in plain words — who is absent, what a payslip figure means, where a setting lives — and get the answer from your own data.

features.title: SaaS Platform
features.desc: Run multiple companies from one tenant, with plans, billing and GST invoicing.

app.title: Your HR office in every employee's pocket
app.lead: The SmartPRS Android app: scan the gate QR to punch in and out, see attendance, apply for leave, download payslips and approve requests — with each phone activated once with a code.

pricing.note: SMARTPRS 3.0 PRICING (owner, 12 Nov 2026) — same logic as smartprs.com (SmartPRS 2 BillingController::priceFor): per month = plan price + extra employees above the plan x the plan's extra-employee rate + extra companies x company_fee; x advance months; less the period discount; + setup & onboarding (never discounted); + GST (config/gst.json). Above the largest plan: Contact Sales. On-premises: one-time lifetime licence; AMC = amc_percent of the licence a year. Setup & onboarding = base + per_employee x employees ("base_plus") or the larger of the two ("max").

onprem.capacity_note: Licensed employee capacity is confirmed in your quotation.

about.title: Built inside the industry, not just for it
about.body:
SmartPRS was not designed in a software lab. Since 2019, Ametecs has built every product on a community-development model — growing through regular feedback, real experiences, pain points and ideas shared by industry leaders, experienced professionals and domain experts from India's collections & recovery world.

That is how SmartDCM, our debt collection platform, was built — by deeply studying each client's requirement and answering it with innovative, practical solutions. The same method now powers SmartPRS: every module — from biometric attendance and statutory payroll to incentive engines and DRA/PCC compliance — exists because someone in the industry asked for it. That is what makes SmartPRS feel familiar from the very first login.
about.proof: SmartDCM by Ametecs today serves 300+ collection agencies with 2,500+ users across India.
about.founder_role: Founder & Managing Director, Ametecs India Pvt. Ltd.
